output.text: {"notes":["The requested readout time is absolute simulation time t=2.0 s; position, swing angle, and angular velocity are in the world frame.","World coordinates are right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; position is reported in metres.","Swing angle is an unwrapped right-hand angle in radians, and angular velocity is in rad/s.","The scheduled support intervention runs on [0.53, 0.73) s; boundary_crossed denotes whether the load COM crosses x=0.1 m with 0.005 m hysteresis after the cutoff."]}
